Creates a WF checking context for a function item, retrieves its function signature, and delegates signature validation to the shared function/method checker; this method calls `enter_wf_checking_ctxt` from the Methods List.

Checks the type of a static/const/foreign static by normalizing it, registering its WF obligation, requiring `Sized` unless a foreign tail type is allowed, and requiring `Sync` for eligible shared statics; this method calls `enter_wf_checking_ctxt`, `normalize`, and `register_wf_obligation` from the Methods List.

Checks an impl by entering a WF context, validating either the implemented trait reference via trait obligations or the self type directly for inherent impls, and then checking the impl's where-clauses; this method calls `enter_wf_checking_ctxt`, `normalize`, `register_wf_obligation`, and `check_where_clauses` from the Methods List.

Validates where-clauses and generic defaults for an item by checking concrete default type/const arguments for WF, analyzing which predicates mention the item's own parameters, normalizing and instantiating relevant predicates, and registering the resulting WF obligations; this method calls `tcx` and `register_wf_obligation` from the Methods List.
Records encountered type parameters by inserting `ty::Param` indices into the set, then continues recursive traversal by calling `super_visit_with`.
Stops traversal at regions by immediately returning `ControlFlow::BREAK` and calling no other listed methods.
Records encountered const parameters by inserting `ConstKind::Param` indices into the set, then continues recursive traversal by calling `super_visit_with`.

Performs well-formedness checking for a function or method signature by liberating late-bound regions, normalizing each input/output component separately, registering WF obligations for every parameter and the return type, checking the item's where-clauses, and validating RPITIT bounds on the return type. This method calls `check_return_position_impl_trait_in_trait_bounds` from the Methods List.

Validates a method's `self` receiver type by normalizing the method signature, `Self` type, and receiver type, then checking receiver legality with or without `arbitrary_self_types` and emitting either the standard invalid-receiver error or a feature-gate error as appropriate. This method calls `receiver_is_valid` and `e0307` from the Methods List.
Emits error E0307 for an invalid `self` parameter type, adding explanatory note and help text. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Checks whether a method receiver type is a valid form of `self` by first allowing direct equality with `Self`, then autodereferencing the receiver until it can be equated with `Self`, registering autoderef obligations on success, and—when `arbitrary_self_types` is disabled—requiring each deref step to implement the `Receiver` trait. This method calls `receiver_is_implemented` from the Methods List.

Tests whether a candidate receiver type satisfies the lang-item `Receiver` trait by building a trait obligation and querying whether it must hold modulo regions. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Checks a type definition for unused/bivariant generic parameters by collecting parameters constrained by non-bivariant variance or predicates, lazily computing which parameters are explicitly bounded in HIR, and reporting each remaining unconstrained parameter. This method calls `report_bivariance` from the Methods List.

Builds and emits the unused-parameter diagnostic for a bivariant generic parameter, including marker-type and possible const-parameter suggestions when applicable. This method calls `error_392` from the Methods List.

Checks elaborated predicates under an empty param environment for trivially false global bounds: it elaborates predicates, normalizes eligible global predicates, registers them as obligations, and finally calls `select_all_obligations_or_error`.
Constructs a `CheckTypeWellFormedVisitor` from the given `TyCtxt` and calls no other listed methods.
Parallel visitor entry for items that clones the visitor and forwards to `Visitor::visit_item`.
Parallel visitor entry for trait items that clones the visitor and forwards to `Visitor::visit_trait_item`.
Parallel visitor entry for impl items that clones the visitor and forwards to `Visitor::visit_impl_item`.
Parallel visitor entry for foreign items that clones the visitor and forwards to `Visitor::visit_foreign_item`.
Supplies the HIR nested visit map by returning `self.tcx.hir()`.
Visits an item by forcing `check_item_well_formed` through `tcx.ensure()` and then continuing traversal with `hir_visit::walk_item`.
Visits a trait item by forcing `check_trait_item_well_formed` through `tcx.ensure()` and then continuing traversal with `hir_visit::walk_trait_item`.
Visits an impl item by forcing `check_impl_item_well_formed` through `tcx.ensure()` and then continuing traversal with `hir_visit::walk_impl_item`.
Checks the well-formedness of a generic parameter by calling `check_param_wf`, then continues traversal with `hir_visit::walk_generic_param`.

Builds an `AdtVariant` for a struct/union-like variant by iterating fields, fetching each field type, calling `normalize_associated_types_in`, then `resolve_vars_if_possible`, and collecting the resulting `AdtField`s.
Builds `AdtVariant` data for every enum variant by iterating variants and calling `non_enum_variant` for each variant's fields while also recording explicit discriminant def-ids.

Computes the set of types contributing implied bounds for an impl: for trait impls it calls `normalize_associated_types_in` on the trait ref and collects its substituted types, and for inherent impls it calls `normalize_associated_types_in` on `self` type and returns that singleton set.
Creates the base E0392 diagnostic for an unused generic parameter and labels the parameter span as unused. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/check/regionck: Trait method declaration for adding implied outlives bounds derived from function-signature or well-formedness types into an outlives environment. It calls `add_implied_bounds` via the concrete implementor.

Iterates over the provided types, resolves inference variables in each type, computes implied outlives bounds for the body, and records those bounds in the environment. It calls `resolve_vars_if_possible`, `implied_outlives_bounds`, and `add_outlives_bounds`.

Runs late region checking for a standalone expression body by constructing a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, saving implied bounds for the body owner, then—if type checking has not already errored—calling `visit_body` and `visit_region_obligations`. It finishes by skipping classic region resolution because NLL handles it.

Performs item/WF region checking by creating a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, extending the outlives environment via `add_implied_bounds`, saving those bounds, then calling `visit_region_obligations` and `resolve_regions_and_report_errors`.

Runs region checking for a function body by creating a RegionCtxt with `RegionCtxt::new`, adding and saving implied bounds from the function WF/signature types via `add_implied_bounds`, and, if no prior typeck errors exist, calling `visit_fn_body`. It ends by skipping classic region resolution in favor of NLL.
Returns the wrapped `FnCtxt`, letting `RegionCtxt` transparently dereference to the underlying function type-checking context.
Constructs a new RegionCtxt for a body/subject pair, initializing a fresh `OutlivesEnvironment` and storing the function context, current body id, body owner, and subject def-id.
Resolves inference variables in a type while leaving region variables available for later lifetime constraint collection by calling `resolve_vars_if_possible`.
Fetches the type of a HIR node with `node_ty` and then calls `resolve_type` to normalize unresolved inference variables.

Sets up region checking for a function or closure body by updating the current body state, collecting input/output types to derive implied bounds, then calling `add_implied_bounds`, `save_implied_bounds`, `link_fn_params`, `visit_body`, and `visit_region_obligations`.

Region-checks an inline const body in an isolated outlives-environment snapshot: it saves state, updates the current body, saves implied bounds, then calls `visit_body` and `visit_region_obligations`, and finally restores the previous snapshot and body state.
Processes any pending trait/type obligations that may generate additional region constraints by calling `select_all_obligations_or_error`.

Completes classic region solving for item checking by calling `process_registered_region_obligations` with the outlives environment’s region-bound pairs, then `fcx.resolve_regions_and_report_errors` for the current subject.
Applies drop-liveness constraints to each pattern binding by iterating bindings, calling `resolve_node_type` for each bound variable type, and then `dropck::check_drop_obligations`.
Handles nested closure bodies during HIR traversal by snapshotting the outlives environment, calling `visit_fn_body` on the closure body, and then restoring the previous snapshot and body state.
Visits a match arm by first calling `constrain_bindings_in_pat` on the arm pattern, then delegating the rest of traversal to `intravisit::walk_arm`.
Visits a local binding by calling `constrain_bindings_in_pat` for drop constraints, `link_local` to relate initializer borrows to the pattern, and then `intravisit::walk_local`.

Visits expressions while building region constraints: it first calls `constrain_adjustments`, then `check_safety_of_rvalue_destructor_if_necessary` on the resulting place when available, and dispatches by expression kind to call `link_addr_of` for `&` borrows, `link_match` for matches, `visit_inline_const` for const blocks, or otherwise continue traversal with `intravisit::walk_expr`.
Creates a `MemCategorizationContext` from the current inference context, param env, body owner, and typeck results, then invokes the supplied callback with it.

Computes region constraints introduced by autoderef/autoref adjustments. It calls `with_mc` to categorize the unadjusted expression, `check_safety_of_rvalue_destructor_if_necessary` before applying adjustments, and then for each adjustment may call `link_region` for overloaded deref borrows or `link_autoref` for autorefs, finishing by re-categorizing the adjusted expression with `with_mc`.
For a pure rvalue place, enforces any drop-related outlives requirements by calling `resolve_type` on the place type and then `dropck::check_drop_obligations`.
Registers a region obligation requiring a type to outlive a region by calling `register_region_obligation` on the inference context.
Builds region constraints for an explicit `&` borrow by categorizing the base expression with `with_mc` and then calling `link_region_from_node_type` using the borrow expression’s reference type.

Relates a local initializer to its binding pattern: if an initializer exists, it categorizes it with `with_mc` and then calls `link_pattern` to propagate borrow-region constraints into the pattern bindings.
Relates a match discriminant to each arm pattern by categorizing the discriminant with `with_mc` and then calling `link_pattern` for every arm.
Creates rvalue categorizations for function parameters and links them to their patterns by calling `with_mc` for each parameter and then `link_pattern`.

Walks a pattern against a categorized source place by calling `with_mc`/`cat_pattern`; for each by-reference binding it detects, it calls `link_region_from_node_type` to enforce the binding’s borrow lifetime.
Applies region constraints for an implicit autoref adjustment: for `AutoBorrow::Ref` it calls `link_region`, while raw-pointer autoref adjustments add no region constraints.
Extracts the reference region from a node’s resolved type by calling `resolve_node_type`, and if the type is `&T`, calls `link_region` to relate that borrow region to the borrowed place.

Core borrow-linking routine: it first calls `type_must_outlive` to require the borrowed place type to outlive the borrow region, then walks dereferenced pointer layers and may call `link_reborrowed_region` for nested references or `link_upvar_region` for upvar captures, stopping early on raw pointers or when reborrow handling determines no further recursion is needed.

Adds the fundamental reborrow constraint that the new borrow region is a subregion of the referenced region by calling `sub_regions(infer::Reborrow(...), ...)`, and returns whether reborrow propagation should stop based on mutability/borrow semantics.

Constrains borrows of captured upvars so they cannot outlive the closure environment borrow. It inspects closure capture info and, for by-reference captures, calls `sub_regions(infer::ReborrowUpvar(...), ...)`; for by-value closure captures it additionally analyzes the closure type and synthesized free region information to derive the required relation.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/trait: Sets the candidate set to `ProjectionCandidateSet::Ambiguous`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Adds a projection candidate when possible, deduplicates identical candidates, prefers `ParamEnv` candidates over others, and otherwise converts a conflicting single candidate into ambiguity. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Handles higher-ranked projection equality by instantiating the obligation binder with placeholders inside a probe and then calling `project_and_unify_type`. It converts mismatches into `MismatchedProjectionTypes` and, when experimenting with extended GATs, filters out obligations that mention the newly created universe before returning `Holds`.

Solves a concrete projection equality by first calling `opt_normalize_projection_type` to normalize the projection, then replacing opaque types in the expected term with inference variables, and finally equating the normalized and expected terms. It returns `Holds` with accumulated obligations on success, or reports failed normalization, recursion, or mismatched projection types.
Creates an empty obligation list, calls `normalize_to` to normalize the given foldable value, and returns both the normalized value and the collected obligations packaged in `Normalized`.
Delegates normalization to `normalize_with_depth_to` with recursion depth 0, forwarding the caller-provided obligation sink.

Convenience entry point for normalization at a given recursion depth: it allocates an obligation buffer, calls `normalize_with_depth_to`, and packages the normalized value together with the collected obligations.

Normalizes a foldable value into a caller-provided obligation buffer by constructing an `AssocTypeNormalizer` with `AssocTypeNormalizer::new` and then calling its `fold` method under stack protection.

Like `normalize_with_depth_to`, but uses a normalizer configured to avoid eager inference replacement: it calls `AssocTypeNormalizer::new_without_eager_inference_replacement` and then invokes `AssocTypeNormalizer::fold` under stack protection.

Checks whether a value contains projection-, inherent-, const-projection-, or optionally opaque-related type flags that require normalization, depending on the `Reveal` mode. It does not call other methods in this list.
Constructs an `AssocTypeNormalizer` configured for normal eager inference replacement, after asserting the old trait solver path is in use. It does not call other methods in this list.
Constructs an `AssocTypeNormalizer` configured to avoid eager inference replacement. It does not call other methods in this list.

Top-level normalization helper for the normalizer: it resolves inference variables, asserts there are no escaping bound vars, calls `needs_normalization` to fast-path already-normal values, and otherwise recursively folds the value.
Returns the type context for the normalizer by calling `self.selcx.tcx()`.
Enters a new binder universe, calls `super_fold_with` to recursively normalize the binder contents, then exits the universe.

Core type-normalization folder for associated types and opaque types. It first skips work when `needs_normalization` is false, otherwise recursively folds substructure with `super_fold_with`, checks recursion limits via `tcx`, and normalizes projection types by calling `normalize_projection_type` or `opt_normalize_projection_type`; it also uses bound-variable replacement and placeholder restoration around projection normalization when binders are involved.
Normalizes constants unless lazy normalization is enabled. It calls `super_fold_with` to fold nested structure, then evaluates the folded constant with `with_replaced_escaping_bound_vars` and `eval`.

Entry point for converting bound regions, types, and consts into placeholders while recording reverse mappings. It constructs a `BoundVarReplacer`, folds the input through it, and returns the rewritten value plus the collected maps.
Finds or lazily creates the universe index associated with a given de Bruijn level, extending the tracked universe stack as necessary. It does not call other methods in this list.
Returns the inference context's type context directly.
Adjusts the current Debruijn depth for a nested binder, calls `super_fold_with` to replace bound variables inside it, then restores the previous depth.

Replaces late-bound regions at or above the current binder with placeholder regions, using `universe_for` to choose the universe and `mk_region` to build the replacement; regions outside that range are left unchanged.

Replaces bound types at or above the current binder with placeholder types, calling `universe_for` and `mk_ty` for the replacement; if the type merely contains deeper bound variables, it calls `super_fold_with` to recurse, otherwise it returns the type unchanged.
Replaces bound constants at or above the current binder with placeholder constants, using `universe_for` and `mk_const`; for all other constants it calls `super_fold_with` to recurse.
Entry point for converting placeholders back into bound vars using previously recorded maps and universe information. It constructs a `PlaceholderReplacer` and folds the input through it.
Returns the inference context's type context directly.
Skips binders with no placeholders or infer regions; otherwise adjusts binder depth, calls `super_fold_with` to restore placeholders under the binder, and then restores the previous depth.

Resolves inference regions opportunistically, then converts mapped placeholder regions back into late-bound regions by consulting the stored universe mapping and calling `tcx().mk_region`; unmapped regions are returned as-is.

Converts mapped placeholder types back into bound types using the stored universe mapping and `tcx().mk_ty`; if the type still contains placeholders or infer regions in substructure, it calls `super_fold_with`, otherwise it returns the type unchanged.
Converts mapped placeholder constants back into bound constants via `tcx().mk_const`; for non-placeholder constants it calls `super_fold_with` to recurse.

Public entry point that normalizes an associated-type projection to a `Term`. It explicitly calls `opt_normalize_projection_type`; if that returns no concrete result due to ambiguity, it falls back to `infer_projection` to create an inference variable and deferred obligations.

Attempts to normalize a projection type with recursion detection and projection-cache support, returning either a concrete normalized term, ambiguity, or in-progress recursion. It explicitly calls `project` to compute the projection when cache lookup does not decide the result, and then records progress, ambiguity, or errors back into the cache while extending the caller's obligations.

Produces an error-tolerant normalized term by creating a fresh type or const inference variable and adding the projected trait obligation so trait solving can continue. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Constructs a `Progress` value whose term is an error type and whose obligations list is empty; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Appends additional obligations to an existing `Progress` result and returns it; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Top-level projection solver that checks recursion and prior errors, assembles candidates from the parameter environment, trait definition, object bounds, and impl selection, then either confirms a unique candidate or returns ambiguity/error/no-progress. It calls `assemble_candidates_from_param_env`, `assemble_candidates_from_trait_def`, `assemble_candidates_from_object_ty`, `assemble_candidates_from_impls`, `confirm_candidate`, `Progress::error`, and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous`/`ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_error` indirectly through candidate assembly outcomes.
Collects projection candidates from the caller bounds in the parameter environment. It calls `assemble_candidates_from_predicates`.

Scans item bounds from the trait definition for matching projection clauses, pushes matching trait-definition candidates, and marks ambiguity when matching cannot be decided. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::push_candidate` and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous`.

Builds projection candidates from object type projection bounds when the trait supports object-based projection, and marks ambiguity if the self type is still a type variable. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous` and `assemble_candidates_from_predicates`.

Filters a stream of projection predicates by associated item and argument compatibility, probes whether each can match the goal, and either pushes a candidate or marks ambiguity. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::push_candidate` and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous`.

Selects the underlying trait obligation to derive impl-based projection candidates, then records ambiguity, selection error, or a usable builtin/user-defined candidate while accounting for specialization and builtin trait cases. It calls `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_ambiguous` and `ProjectionCandidateSet::mark_error`.

Turns a chosen projection candidate into concrete projected progress by delegating to the appropriate confirmation routine and then opportunistically resolving inferred regions in the resulting term. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate` for `ParamEnv`, `Object`, and `TraitDef` candidates, and `confirm_select_candidate` for `Select` candidates.

Confirms an impl-selected candidate by dispatching to the appropriate builtin or user-defined confirmation path based on the selected impl source and trait kind. It calls `confirm_impl_candidate`, `confirm_coroutine_candidate`, `confirm_future_candidate`, `confirm_iterator_candidate`, `confirm_async_iterator_candidate`, `confirm_closure_candidate`, `confirm_fn_pointer_candidate`, `confirm_async_closure_candidate`, `confirm_async_fn_kind_helper_candidate`, and `confirm_builtin_candidate`.

Handles projection for generator associated types (`Yield`/`Return`) by resolving the obligation self type as a generator, normalizing its generator signature with `normalize_with_depth`, building the corresponding generator projection predicate via `generator_trait_ref_and_outputs`, and then delegating final confirmation to `confirm_param_env_candidate`. It returns that result augmented with the incoming nested obligations and the obligations produced during signature normalization via `with_addl_obligations`.

Confirms a `DiscriminantKind`-style projection by resolving the self type, constructing the corresponding discriminant projection predicate, and delegating final confirmation to `confirm_param_env_candidate`.

Confirms a `Pointee`/metadata projection by computing pointer metadata for the resolved self type, normalizing nested metadata types with `normalize_with_depth_to`, optionally adding a `Sized` obligation, and then delegating to `confirm_param_env_candidate`; it returns the result augmented with the extra obligations via `with_addl_obligations`.
Normalizes a function pointer signature and confirms its callable output projection via the shared callable path. It calls `confirm_callable_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.

Builds the effective callable signature for closures or coroutine-closures, including async/coroutine-specific output construction when needed, then confirms the resulting callable projection. It calls `confirm_callable_candidate` and `Progress::with_addl_obligations`.
Constructs the `FnOnce::Output` projection predicate from a callable signature and confirms it through the param-env projection path. It calls `confirm_param_env_candidate`.

Confirms a projection candidate taken from the parameter environment by instantiating the cached binder, normalizing the obligation projection and optionally the candidate projection with `normalize_with_depth_to`, equating the two projections via inference, and on success extending obligations and calling `assoc_ty_own_obligations`; on failure it returns an error term.

Confirms a projection candidate coming from a selected impl by locating the associated item in the impl, rebasing and translating trait/impl arguments, building the resulting associated term from the impl item definition, checking argument compatibility, and then calling `assoc_ty_own_obligations` before instantiating the term; if the impl item is missing or incompatible it returns an error progress.

Collects and adds the associated item's own declared predicates as nested obligations by instantiating the item's predicates, normalizing each predicate with `normalize_with_depth_to`, choosing an appropriate obligation cause, and pushing each normalized predicate as a deeper obligation.

Finds the concrete associated item definition for an impl, first checking the impl's own item map directly and otherwise querying specialization ancestors with `leaf_def`; it returns the matching `LeafDef` or reports an internal bug if no associated item exists.

Declares a conversion hook that builds `Self` from a polymorphic projection predicate within a `SelectionContext`. As a trait/interface method declaration, it has no body and does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Builds a `ProjectionCacheKey` for a poly projection predicate only when it has no bound vars. It explicitly calls `ProjectionCacheKey::new` after resolving inference variables in the predicate's projection type with `resolve_vars_if_possible`.

Builds the represented type for an opaque item as either a projection when `in_trait` is true or an opaque type otherwise, lowers its AST bounds into predicates, adds the implicit `Sized` bound when applicable, and allocates the resulting explicit bounds without inheriting parent predicates. Calls `AstConv::compute_bounds` and `AstConv::add_implicitly_sized`.

Dispatches bound collection based on the HIR node for `def_id`: for trait associated types it calls `associated_type_bounds`, and for opaque types it calls `opaque_type_bounds`; any other node kind is rejected with `bug!`.

Computes the full elaborated item bounds by taking `explicit_item_bounds`, extracting their predicates, elaborating them with `util::elaborate_predicates`, and interning the final predicate list with `mk_predicates`. Calls `explicit_item_bounds`.

Constructs an `NllTypeRelatingDelegate` by storing the provided type-checking context, locations, constraint category, and universe diagnostic info. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns the source span for the current MIR location by querying `self.locations.span(self.type_checker.body)`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns the `ParamEnv` stored in the enclosing `TypeChecker`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Creates a fresh inference universe via the inference context, records the associated `UniverseInfo` in the borrow-checker constraint store, and returns the new universe index. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Allocates and returns a fresh existential NLL region variable, tagging its origin as existential and preserving whether it came from a `forall`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Obtains or creates the region corresponding to a placeholder binder, derives a diagnostic name for debug tracking, and in debug builds records the placeholder origin for the region variable. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Creates a fresh existential region variable in the specified universe and, in debug builds, records its origin metadata for diagnostics. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Converts the related super- and sub-regions into region variable IDs and pushes a corresponding `OutlivesConstraint` with the current locations, span, category, and variance info into the borrow-checker constraints. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.
No-op delegate hook for const equality during type relating; it does not call any other methods in the provided Methods List.
Returns the eager normalization strategy for this type-relating delegate and does not call any other methods in the provided Methods List.
Reports that inference variables are forbidden during this relation process by always returning `true`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Registers an opaque-type relation by building an obligation cause from the current parameter environment and span, invoking the inference context's opaque-type handling, and then executing the resulting instantiation operation through the type checker. Constructs a fresh `RegionConstraintStorage` by delegating to `Self::default()`. It does not call any other methods from the Methods List.
Wraps the storage together with an undo log into a `RegionConstraintCollector` so mutations can be tracked for snapshots and rollback. It does not call any other methods from the Methods List.

Returns the origin metadata recorded for a given region variable. It does not call any other methods from the Methods List.

Interns a subregion constraint with its origin into the constraint map only if it is not already present, and records an undo entry for newly inserted constraints. It does not call any other methods from the Methods List.

Adds a given outlives pair to the set if it is new and records an `AddGiven` undo entry for rollback support. It does not call any other methods from the Methods List.
